name: codex-explainer-video-plugin
description: Create storyboard-based explainer videos using Codex image generation, Real-ESRGAN upscaling, OpenAI voiceover, Remotion shape animation, essential text overlays, and local FFmpeg composition.

interface.shortDescription: Generate explainer videos with animated shapes and text
interface.longDescription: Uses Codex's built-in image generation for storyboard artwork, the Explainer Media MCP server for Real-ESRGAN upscaling and OpenAI TTS, Remotion for editable shape animation and essential text, and FFmpeg for final delivery.
defaultPrompt: Create a 40-second explainer video from this topic.
Turn this script into a storyboard video with voiceover.
Generate an explainer video using a single storyboard image.
Explain this topic with animated diagrams and only necessary on-screen text.
